page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.14xlarge is a storage-focused virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor architecture. It is built around an x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 56 dedicated vCPUs. The server incorporates 224.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio.

Storage functionality is central to this configuration, which features 165,356 GB of local HDD storage. Network throughput is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 17 Gbps. The server does not contain discrete GPU hardware accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its combination of 56 vCPUs, 224.0 GB RAM, and extensive local HDD storage capacity, the ecs.d1.14xlarge is intended for mass data processing, big data analytics clusters, log aggregation systems, and high-capacity local database storage applications.
